body.name: \(\mathfrak H^{\mathrm{up}}\)
body.construction: Compute the deterministic objects in \(\mathrm{def{:}upper\text{-}tuning\text{-}grid}\), the B-spline and atomic characteristic-function families in \(\mathrm{def{:}signal\text{-}sieves}\) and \(\mathrm{def{:}error\text{-}sieves}\), the radii in \(\mathrm{def{:}ecf\text{-}radii}\), and the compact feasibility set \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\). Then apply the profiled ADRF map and the ordered endpoint rule in \(\mathrm{def{:}profiled\text{-}band}\), including its lexicographic and empty-set conventions. This deterministic profiling rule uses only \((O_1,\ldots,O_n)\), the fixed class indices, \(n\), and \(\alpha\). It is finite-dimensional but semi-infinite because its continuum signal constraints are imposed exactly; no finite decision algorithm or certified numerical approximation is claimed.
